About tkmulti

A studio built for work that crosses borders.

tkmulti started in Johannesburg with one rule: make things that don't need to be dumbed down or re-shot to land somewhere else. Nine years on, that's still the whole job.

We're a small, senior team that treats every market like a first language, not a translation. One story, cut for every screen it needs to live on.

AI Tools

Faster iteration, still a human final cut.

We built a small internal toolkit to speed up the parts of production that don't need a person yet — so more time goes into the parts that do.

Auto-Grade

An AI colour-grading assistant that proposes a look from reference stills, so grading starts from a draft instead of a blank timeline.

VoiceLocal

AI-assisted dubbing and localisation passes for voiceover, used as a first draft that a human director then performs over and approves.

ScoreSketch

Generates rough musical sketches against picture so our composers can react to something instead of starting from silence.

BriefBot

Turns a client's goals and constraints into a structured creative brief in minutes, ready for the team to push back on and refine.
